title: Add Descriptly to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Descriptly](https://github.com/g33ky00/descriptly) to writing
- ## Descriptly v1.0.0 First public release. Descriptly scans images added or modified in a pull request and generates accessible alt-text suggestions using Pollinations vision models — posted directly 

Fixes #13889

gist.headline: Alt text grows here
gist.blurb: Descriptly joined the writing garden. It watches pull-request images and leaves accessible alt-text suggestions behind, which is a much nicer use of computer vision than staring at screenshots until everyone agrees.
gist.summary: Added Descriptly v1.0.0 to the writing apps directory: it scans images added or changed in pull requests and posts accessible alt-text suggestions generated with Pollinations vision models.
gist.impact: Developers can now discover Descriptly through the writing collection and use Pollinations vision models to make PR image changes easier to describe accessibly.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy open-source garden workspace where Descriptly turns pull-request image cards into small, readable alt-text notes. Polli acts as an attentive editor with a tiny librarian hat, while a CRT monitor robot presents a PR screenshot and a blooming code-plant represents accessibility growing from the review process.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden hackerspace where Polli, a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears a tiny librarian hat and writes alt-text notes beside a retro pull-request terminal; a cute CRT monitor robot holds an image card with a simple pixel-font label, “ALT TEXT,” while code-plants and flowers bloom around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
